verdict.rationale: Wise documents the building blocks of a consolidated finance stack in one product. Its multi-currency account holds balances in up to 56 currencies with optional FDIC passthrough insurance (banking). It issues debit cards with MCC- and currency-based spend controls (spend). It supports API business payments and batch groups of up to 1000 transfers, which covers outbound payments. However, there is no documented bill-pay workflow and no explicit positioning as a replacement for multiple point solutions. Missing for 10: documented bill-pay features (invoice intake, approvals, scheduled bill payments), explicit consolidation or all-in-one positioning, and independent hands-on corroboration of replacing other tools.

support.subject: As a founder, I can replace multiple point solutions for spend, bill pay, and banking with one consolidated platform

citations.quote: The Wise multi-currency account (MCA) enables users to hold, convert, and fund transfers (single or batches) with balances in up to 56 currencies.
Opt in and get passthrough FDIC insurance up to $250,000 through our Program Bank.
Control which card transactions are permitted by creating rules based on merchant category code (MCC) or transaction currency.
How to make business payments via API from a Wise account.
A batch group is a named collection of up to 1000 transfers that can be managed as a single unit.
